value.rationale: The result is a sharp, dimension-explicit global sign obstruction for a canonical signed metric invariant at a central site, requiring no orbit symmetry or positive rim weights. It characterizes an extremal interval over every finite spherical cloud with the center in its convex hull, with two unrelated boundary sequences and nontrivial essential-hypothesis threshold at two rim sites. It is neither a known-table recomputation nor an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
